title: Jorge's Custom HUDs
description: Adds two sci-fi themed HUDs with multiple color variants. Includes custom health, hunger and oxygen notification sounds.
body:
This mod adds 2 custom HUDs that can be swapped between using the config.
Player stats are displayed in percentages, saturation is displayed, and the percentages adapt to the player's max health.

The mod includes customization for the following:
- Color and variant based on hud type.
  
- Time and day indicators (24 hour cycle, AM - PM).
- Health, hunger and oxygen warning sounds (sound based on selected HUD) with customizable warning percentages.
- HUD background for better visibility

Included huds types:
1. Lm9 HUD: 11 color variants, more polygonal.![Lm9 HUD (cyan/variant 6)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4b573ceaa713c24d2ca1e938ddc91d13aedf0c6.png)
2. GRN HUD: overcharged variant, sniper variant (variants are combinable).![GRN HUD (standard variant)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/971590cfe6cfed3830ac32b0f849da5d7e18fde3.png)
